marks.gloss_en: מאי טעמא? לפי שאין אומרים הבא גיסטרא לגיסטרא
לא קשיא: הא ברברבי, והא בזוטרי -- this [a pomegranate-hole] of large vessels, this [most broken] of small ones
Rav Asi: they teach -- the measure of an earthenware vessel is [a hole] letting liquid in
and one said: [the measure of an earthenware vessel is a hole] like a small root
המושיט חייב... שכך היתה עבודת הלוים -- handing between wagons on one level was the Levites' service
two balconies opposite each other across the public domain: one who hands from one to the other is exempt
one who throws from a private domain to the public domain is liable
two wagons one behind the other in the public domain: they handed the beams from one to the other
